main.description: Stores an artifact, or one part of a large artifact, as a blob of a package, for a release that 'dev.zena-lang.host.publish' writes next. The caller must be a maintainer of the package. A blob no release references is deleted after a while, as a PDS deletes unreferenced blobs.

errors.name: TooLarge
errors.description: The blob is larger than the host stores in one blob; upload it in parts.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The package's scope has used the storage the host allows.
